READY WHEN YOU ARE

Bring your profile to life.

Install PROFILE-lyn and ECO-API-lyn 1.1.0 on your Fabric 26.2 server, alongside Fabric API.

Players also need Fabric API and ECO-API-lyn 1.1.0 on their clients. Shop servers additionally require SHOP-MOD-lyn 1.1.0 on each client. PROFILE-lyn itself stays on the server.

01

Paste an import command

Copy it into the server console. In Minecraft chat, you must be an operator. The layout is saved immediately.

02

Or use a JSON file

Save as config/profile-lyn/profile.json, then run /profile reload. No rebuild or restart.

Back for another edit?

One editor. An optional economy.

PROFILE-lyn opens your layout with /profile. Use /profile editor as an operator to edit the installed layout.

ECO-API-lyn is an optional server-only integration that stores balances and provides /balance, /pay Player 10.50, and /baltop. Operators can use /eco give Player 100, take, or set. Install ECO-API-lyn 1.0.0 or newer on the server to enable balances. Players do not need either mod. Your shop can integrate through its Java API.

{money} shows the player's real ECO-API-lyn balance, or "Unavailable" without ECO. The canvas uses sample values. Hover text refreshes in-game every second.

Personalize your hover text

Use Minecraft color codes such as &a for green, &b for aqua, and &l for bold. {score:objective} reads a vanilla scoreboard.

Changes are saved in this browser. Export to apply them to the server. Item previews use vanilla textures; special models and block shapes can look different in-game.
